classes.name: index
classes.reason: In _consume the read of each class_a file is aborted once 'probe.NS() - started > budget_ns', a hard per-unit time window derived from the producer's broadcast timing, so the read (called exactly once per file via read_staged) either finishes inside that window or the remaining files are dropped, while producers/idle ranks are already parked at the shared barrier.broadcast()/barrier.wait() calls waiting for this bounded read to resolve before the unit can advance.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report reads each class_b file CLASS_B_READS (8) times per unit via the nested 'for _pass in range(CLASS_B_READS): ... probe.read_staged(...)' loop with no time bound, and it only executes after _consume finishes, with the other ranks already sitting at the common barrier.wait() doing nothing but waiting for the consumer's unbounded read loop to complete before the next unit starts.
